content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"In-home personal care and home health services funded by government payers; not education."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for adult learners, funded by tuition and federal aid, like Perdoceo."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"In-home pediatric and adult nursing and therapy services paid by Medicaid; a healthcare services business, not education."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Professional employer organization offering payroll, HR and workers' compensation insurance to businesses."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Senior living communities and resident care paid by residents and Medicare; a real estate and care operator."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Outsources marketing and enrollment services to one university under contract; does not sell degrees to students."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Consulting, analytics and managed services sold to hospitals, universities and companies; not a degree provider."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Accredited for-profit career colleges training adult students for allied health careers, paid by student tuition."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Online and campus degree and certificate programs for working adults, funded by student tuition and federal aid."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Contract staffing of engineers, healthcare workers and IT professionals billed by the hour to corporate clients."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"K-12 virtual public schools sold under per-student contracts to public school districts; different customers and level."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; a financial intermediary, not an education provider."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Tuition-paid career training with federal aid for adult students, though focused on hands-on technical programs at campuses."}]}
